title: Making Tea
text:
Lucas makes tea every morning. He boils water in a small pot. He puts one bag of tea in a cup. He adds milk and sugar.

Then he pours the hot water into the cup. He waits for three minutes. The tea is hot and sweet. Lucas drinks it with bread.

questions.text: Where does Lucas boil the water?
How does Lucas probably feel about his morning tea?
Why does Lucas wait before he drinks the tea?
options: So the tea can get ready to drink
So he can go back to sleep

vocabulary.definition: a deep container used for cooking liquids
stays in one place until something happens

paragraph_translations: Lucas faz chá todas as manhãs. Ele ferve água em uma panela pequena. Ele coloca um saquinho de chá em uma xícara. Ele adiciona leite e açúcar.
Depois, ele despeja a água quente na xícara. Ele espera por três minutos. O chá está quente e doce. Lucas bebe com pão.
